description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between perplexity and the parameter M (likely representing the number of layers or pruning granularity) for three different models: LLaMAI-7B, LLaMAI-13B, and Vicuna-7B. The x-axis, labeled “M,” ranges from 3 to 8 with integer tick marks, indicating discrete values of M. The y-axis, labeled “Perplexity,” spans from approximately 15 to 45, with major tick marks at intervals of 10. The blue line with triangle markers, representing Vicuna-7B, starts at a perplexity of ~41 at M=3, dips slightly to ~36 at M=4, remains relatively flat through M=7 (~35), then rises to ~40 at M=8. The green line with circle markers, corresponding to LLaMAI-7B, begins at ~29 at M=3, decreases slightly to ~26 at M=4, stays near ~26 at M=5, then gradually increases to ~36 at M=8. The orange line with star markers, for LLaMAI-13B, starts at ~20 at M=3, drops to ~17 at M=4, remains stable around ~17 through M=6, then rises to ~19 at M=7 and ~20 at M=8. All three lines show relatively stable or slowly increasing perplexity as M increases, with LLaMAI-13B consistently exhibiting the lowest perplexity across all M values.
